_comment: Canonical RequestContext and BoundOperator wire shapes. RequestContext is embedded in API request bodies instead of headers. It carries session identity, investigation context, and bound operator metadata. BoundOperator is a sub-model representing an Operator bound to a session.

bound_operator._description: Represents a bound Operator in the request context. Serialized from BoundOperator (protocol/python/g8e/models/context.py).

bound_web_session_id.description: Web session ID this Operator is bound to

request_context._description: Request context embedded in API request bodies. Serialized from RequestContext (protocol/python/g8e/models/context.py). Excludes null fields on the wire.

web_session_id.description: Web user session ID. Required for CLIENT source when cli_session_id is absent.

cli_session_id.description: CLI session ID. Required for CLIENT source when web_session_id is absent.

user_id.description: User identifier. Required for CLIENT source.

bound_operators.description: List of all bound operators. Each item conforms to the bound_operator shape above.

source_component.description: Component that created this context. See status.json component.name.
